mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pisces_experiment_config_version (experiment_id, config_version, metadata_json, published_by, publish_comment, source_config_version, source_type) VALUES (#{entity.experimentId}, #{entity.configVersion}, #{entity.metadataJson}, #{entity.publishedBy}, #{entity.publishComment}, #{entity.sourceConfigVersion}, #{entity.sourceType}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE metadata_json = VALUES(metadata_json), published_by = VALUES(published_by), publish_comment = VALUES(publish_comment), source_config_version = VALUES(source_config_version), source_type = VALUES(source_type), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, experiment_id, config_version, metadata_json, published_by, publish_comment, source_config_version, source_type, created_at, updated_at FROM pisces_experiment_config_version WHERE experiment_id = #{experimentId} ORDER BY config_version DESC
